extracted.name: Classic Stromboli 🇮🇹
extracted.description: #mommajackiesstrombolishowdown This mouthwatering Stromboli is a golden-brown, crispy delight, filled with layers of thinly sliced provolone, prosciutto ham, and zesty Genoa salami. The melted provolone adds a creamy, tangy richness, while the prosciutto ham and Genoa salami bring a savory, slightly peppery bite that’s truly irresistible. Rolled up in a tender pizza dough, this Stromboli is brushed with olive oil and sprinkled with Italian herbs before baking to a crisp perfection. Slice into this warm, savory roll and watch the gooey cheese and flavorful meats swirl together in each satisfying bite.
instruction_lines: Mix the dough recipe. Let’s sit for 30 minutes.
Roll out flat about a quarter inch thick
Roll the dough, crimping the edges and crimping the end to the rest of the dough to make a tight seal
Push the tip of a knife through the top in three different places for vent holes
Brush with olive oil or egg wash sprinkle Italian seasoning on top
Bake in oven on 375 for 20 - 30 minutes
